name: XlDataBarAxisPosition
description: Specifies the axis position for a range of cells with conditional formatting as data bars.

constants.name: xlDataBarAxisAutomatic
constants.description: Display the axis at a variable position based on the ratio of the minimum negative value to the maximum positive value in the range. Positive values are displayed in a left-to-right direction. Negative values are displayed in a right-to-left direction. When all values are positive or all values are negative, no axis is displayed.

constants.name: xlDataBarAxisMidpoint
constants.description: Display the axis at the midpoint of the cell regardless of the set of values in the range. Positive values are displayed in a left-to-right direction. Negative values are displayed in a right-to-left direction.

constants.name: xlDataBarAxisNone
constants.description: No axis is displayed, and both positive and negative values are displayed in the left-to-right direction.
